sections.overview: Compact full-range speaker system.It is also designed for the rear of 4-channel stereo.The unit is equipped with a specially designed and developed 16cm cone type full range speaker.We seek to improve the overall balance by reducing intermodulation distortion, which tends to be a problem.The enclosure adopts a bass reflex system using a pipe duct.The surface has a walnut open pore finish.
